_note: Hand-encoded CheckSpecs. Each 'quote' must appear verbatim in the cited stored clause (checked at load time). validation_status stays 'draft' until a qualified engineer validates it via the API; draft specs can never produce a final compliant / non-compliant status.

specs.title: Ready means of escape from accommodation and work spaces
specs.quote: Stairways and ladders shall be so arranged as to provide ready means of escape to the lifeboat and liferaft embarkation deck from passenger and crew accommodation spaces and from spaces in which the crew is normally employed, other than machinery spaces.
interpretation_notes: The GA does not identify the lifeboat/liferaft embarkation deck; identified open decks / escape markings are used as a proxy.
'Ready' (route quality) is not assessable from connectivity alone.

specs.title: Two means of escape at all levels of accommodation
specs.quote: At all levels of accommodation there shall be provided at least two widely separated means of escape from each restricted space or group of spaces.
interpretation_notes: Evaluated per accommodation corridor (the 'group of spaces' served by it) as node-independent routes to identified escape points.
'Widely separated' is not verified (no separation distance computed).

specs.title: Dead-end corridors not longer than 7 m
specs.quote: No dead-end corridors having a length of more than 7 m shall be accepted.
interpretation_notes: A corridor whose every escape route passes through one exit is treated as a dead end; its length is the walking distance from that exit to the farthest point of the corridor.
Short spurs inside corridors that do have two routes are not measured.

specs.title: Two means of escape from machinery spaces of category A
specs.quote: two means of escape shall be provided from each machinery space of category A.
required_evidence: machinery power / propulsion role (category A definition)
interpretation_notes: Category A (II-2/3.31) depends on main-propulsion use or >= 375 kW aggregate power, which the GA does not state; spaces labelled GENERATOR are screened as candidates.
An 'ESC' marking inside the space is counted as one means of escape (escape trunk); its destination is not verified.

specs.title: Two escape routes from other machinery spaces (5 m exception)
specs.quote: From machinery spaces other than those of category A, two escape routes shall be provided except that a single escape route may be accepted for spaces that are entered only occasionally, and for spaces where the maximum travel distance to the door is 5 m or less.
interpretation_notes: Single-route spaces are accepted when the measured maximum travel distance to the door is 5 m or less.
'Entered only occasionally' cannot be established from the GA.

specs.title: Fire integrity of bulkheads and decks (tables 9.5 / 9.6)
specs.quote: the minimum fire integrity of bulkheads and decks shall be as prescribed in tables 9.5 and 9.6.
required_evidence: fire-integrity class of each separating bulkhead/deck
space category of each adjacent space
interpretation_notes: Tables 9.5/9.6 are not encoded; without division classes on the drawing no comparison is possible.

specs.title: Oil fuel tanks inboard of the side shell by distance w
specs.quote: oil fuel tanks shall be located inboard of the moulded line of the side shell plating, nowhere less than the distance w
interpretation_notes: For 600 m3 <= C < 5,000 m3 the clause gives w = 0.4 + 2.4 C/20,000 m with a minimum of 1.0 m (0.76 m for individual tanks < 500 m3), so w = 1.0 m governs in that range; C and individual tank capacities are not on the GA.
Plan-view distance on one deck only; the regulation measures at any cross-section.

specs.title: Door clear width 815 mm minimum
specs.quote: Door openings shall provide a clear width of 32 inches (815 mm) minimum.
interpretation_notes: Clear width is measured between door face and stop with the door open 90 degrees; a GA swing symbol only gives the leaf width.

specs.title: Door clear width 815 mm minimum (proposed PVAG)
specs.quote: Door openings shall provide a clear width of 32 inches (815 mm) minimum.
interpretation_notes: PVAG are proposed and not finalized.
A GA swing symbol only gives the leaf width.

specs.title: Ballast water management for ships with ballast tanks
specs.quote: all ships in international traffic are required to manage their ballast water and sediments to a certain standard, according to a ship-specific ballast water management plan.
interpretation_notes: The GA can show that ballast tanks exist; the management plan and treatment system are outside the GA.

specs.title: Navigation lights and shapes positioning (Annex I)
specs.quote: There are also four Annexes containing technical requirements concerning lights and shapes and their positioning
required_evidence: navigation light arrangement drawing with heights and sectors
interpretation_notes: The corpus holds only the IMO summary; Annex I values are not available.

specs.title: Freeboard assignment
specs.quote: provisions are made for determining the freeboard of ships by subdivision and damage stability calculations.
interpretation_notes: Freeboard depends on hydrostatics not present in a GA.

specs.title: Ready means of escape from accommodation and work spaces (passenger ship)
specs.quote: Stairways and ladders shall be so arranged as to provide ready means of escape to the lifeboat and liferaft embarkation deck from passenger and crew accommodation spaces and from spaces in which the crew is normally employed, other than machinery spaces.
interpretation_notes: Reg. 13.3.1 applies to all ships; this copy is scoped to passenger ships.
Identified open decks / escape markings are used as a proxy for the embarkation deck.

specs.title: No corridor with only one route of escape (passenger ship)
specs.quote: a corridor, lobby, or part of a corridor from which there is only one route of escape shall be prohibited.
interpretation_notes: A corridor with fewer than two node-independent routes to identified escape points is treated as having one route of escape.
The service-area exception in the same paragraph (fuel oil stations, athwartship supply corridors) is not modelled.

specs.title: Two means of escape from each zone above the bulkhead deck
specs.quote: Above the bulkhead deck there shall be at least two means of escape from each main vertical zone or similarly restricted space or group of spaces at least one of which shall give access to a stairway forming a vertical escape.
interpretation_notes: Evaluated per accommodation corridor (the group of spaces it serves); main vertical zones are not modelled.
The bulkhead deck is not identified; all accommodation corridors are checked.

specs.title: Two means of escape from machinery spaces (passenger ship)
specs.quote: Where the space is below the bulkhead deck, the two means of escape shall consist of either
interpretation_notes: Spaces labelled ENGINE ROOM / GENERATOR are screened; category A status is not confirmed from the GA.
Ladder construction, separation and protected-enclosure details are not assessed.

specs.title: Fire integrity of bulkheads and decks (tables 9.1 / 9.2, > 36 passengers)
specs.quote: the minimum fire integrity of all bulkheads and decks shall be as prescribed in tables 9.1 and 9.2.
required_evidence: documented division class of each boundary (fire-control plan)
space category of each adjacent space
interpretation_notes: Compares the documented class of each boundary with tables 9.1 (bulkheads) / 9.2 (decks), transcribed from the stored clause and checked verbatim by test_fire_integrity.py.
Space categories (1)-(14) are assigned from labels and space type, most stringent where in doubt (9.2.2.3.2.2). Not engineer-validated.
Rows (4) and (5) of table 9.1 are incomplete in the stored text and are not used.

specs.title: Two means of escape from a machinery control room within a machinery space
specs.quote: Two means of escape shall be provided from a machinery control room located within a machinery space
interpretation_notes: Applied to every engine / machinery control room; whether the room is 'within' the machinery space is not decided automatically (a room reached only through the machinery space shows as one route).
Continuous fire shelter of the second route is not assessed.

specs.title: Fixed fire-extinguishing protection of paint lockers
specs.quote: Paint lockers shall be protected by
required_evidence: fire-fighting arrangement plan listing the system protecting each paint locker
interpretation_notes: Reads the system documented for the space in the design data; a GA drawing does not show it, so GA-only designs return insufficient evidence.
Only the presence of a system is checked, not its capacity (40 % CO2, 0.5 kg/m3 powder, 5 l/m2 min water).
